description: BITRE Road Vehicles is a dataset listed in Australian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Road Safety Data. Provides statistics relating to the number of vehicles registered for road use in Australia on 31st January 2023. The statistics have been derived from state and territory motor vehicle registry data. This release replaces the ABS Motor Vehicle Census, which was discontinued in 2021. Coverage: Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Road Safety Data. Its tags are National, Registration, Road, Vehicle. It offers 1 resource(s) in HTML. The portal shows 2026-05-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-au-portal.
